engine.comment: DB2: the database engine is a PROJECT choice, and this is the one place it is declared. A project switching engines edits this block first; README.md's instantiation manifest enumerates the rest of the swap set. The declaration is guarded in both directions rather than trusted: docs-lint puts `image` into DEP-1's cross-surface agreement check, so it cannot drift from the ledger, CI, db-up.sh or the Testcontainers fixture, and EngineChoiceTests boots the PRODUCTION composition and asserts the provider the host actually registers is this one. A declaration nothing checks is the defect this kernel keeps finding, so this one is checked against running code and not against another document.
engine.name: sqlserver
